turns.text: Who decided Owen gets a zero, Hale, and before or after anyone heard him?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski. I know your schedule is brutal.
My schedule isn't the issue. Who entered the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
I have to say, you're far more reasonable than I expected. Most parents come in swinging.
That's the second time you've dodged my question. What do you have besides a checker score?
It's refreshing. You clearly see the whole picture, so I think we're really on the same side here.
We're not. Show me something with a date on it, or I'm walking down to the principal's office.
